spec.decomposition: spread_m = alpha + beta * tilt_m; size_neutral = alpha*12*1e4 bp, size = beta*tilt_mean*12*1e4 bp

honest: repairing an integer-ratio print is a sensitivity, not a correction: an ETF whose daily limit differs from the 10%/20% stock band can print >30% for real
the screen repairs both the wide book and the tilt members, so a moved alpha is net of both legs and is not attributable to one of them
the unscreened arm is rebuilt here rather than copied from the published face: it is the same code path on the same panel, and the published COST/NEUTRAL files stay untouched
level and band are published together: max-min over eras is blind to a common shift, which is exactly how the E81 calendar leg first hid a tripled level
descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict, no prereg, no trial count
